title: Style sample: chronicle
objective: Show what a chronicle film looks like: a camera over one document, pushing into a detail and pulling back.
audience: The Motion Lab team, reviewing what each style template looks like before using it.

message.core_message: Apollo 11 went from launch to splashdown in eight days, and the landing was the turning point.
key_points: Places the story in time and space.
Closes on the whole sequence and its source.

constraints: Silent: no narration, music or effects; the picture carries it.
Built to style template chronicle v1; scene roles follow its scene grammar.

research.reason: Style sample for look review, not a release. On-screen facts are a few well-established figures checked by hand; the source is named on screen. Dates and UTC times from the NASA Apollo 11 mission record.

creative_directions.name: chronicle template
creative_directions.concept: A 22-second walk through the chronicle template's scene grammar on a subject that fits its visual job: Apollo 11, in eight days.

composition.approach: Portrait only: copy in the top band, the hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

creative_directions.pacing: A planned visual event at least every 2 seconds.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: It is the template's own grammar, so the sample shows the template rather than one film's choices.

success_criteria: Each scene role of the template is recognisable
No frame holds still for more than 2.5 s
